wasm.scope: 29 intrinsic dimension cases (8 orientations, native/ordinary pixels, dimension-only queries, 2^40-area display/coded metadata on wasm32, oversized rejection, absent intrinsic) plus additional normalized9/10-bit promotion with source-code recovery, native Gray/GrayAlpha/RGB/RGBA8/12/16 and RGBA8 rounding, pixel limits, RGB/Gray embedded ICC and metadata limits, lossy djxl comparison, jxll levels5/10 with jxlc/jxlp and opaque jbrd, official jbrd still images (25 spatial pixel probes each, full ICC, dimensions, limits, ordinary Gray CMS refusal)

benchmark_method.scope: resident input, full WML2 ordinary/CMS decode, hashes outside timed interval; output metadata creation included
benchmark_method.versions: both cargo build --locked against identical root lock, no scratch dependency resolution
benchmark_method.build: cargo build -p wml2 --locked --release --no-default-features --features jpeg-xl,image-buffer-ex,color-management; distinct private CARGO_TARGET_DIR per tree
benchmark_method.run: taskset -c 0 <probe> <input.jxl> ordinary|managed|info <iterations>; 3 alternating before/after process pairs, 3 warmups per process; info 1 process/1000 calls
benchmark_method.limits: finite host variation; three timed calls per process for large managed image; no general throughput or zero-overhead guarantee; no process RSS measurement

bounds.canvas_limits: unchanged; intrinsic display values do not allocate or spend decoded canvas pixels

limitations: dimension-only JPEG XL info; sample/color/alpha/profile fields remain unknown
prefix success is not later header/container/pixel validation or decode-support guarantee
C libjxl leaves explicit intrinsic fields in source axes; WML2 deliberately normalizes display axes once
larger display declarations accepted by C can still exceed pinned Size restrictions
huge coded fixture is a header-only oracle, not a full huge-pixel encoding
no resampling, new animation/preview runtime behavior, dependency migration or interrupt guarantee
additive metadata keys consume existing metadata/workspace budgets
stacked on unmerged PR57; reconcile independent JXL branches when integrating
